import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

repo = Path("/Users/steventran/jobpipe")
python = str(repo / ".venv" / "bin" / "python")
result = subprocess.run(
    [
        python,
        str(repo / "jobpipe.py"),
        "run",
        "--profile",
        "config/jobpipe.search.yaml",
        "--scout-limit",
        "25",
        "--resolve-limit",
        "10",
    ],
    cwd=repo,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    timeout=900,
)
print(result.stdout)
print(result.stderr)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
